t: Mi sherotzeh laasot hasseder beharbeh battim
s: Mi sherotzeh laasot hasseder beharbeh battim ubo v' seipim: mi sherotzeh laasot hasseder beharbeh battim lepi sheen bahem mi sheyyodea leqaddesh velomar hahaggada vehallel ubirkat hammazon vetzarik lehotziam yede chobatam, ketzad yitnaheg? Yaaseh hasseder techilla bebeto ad leachar shetiyyat kos birkat hammazon, veaz im yirtzeh lelek lebayit acher yiqqach koso shel echad mibbene habbayit vibarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" veqiddush hayyom ve"shehecheyanu", veyachazir lahem hakkos veyishtu kol echad mikkoso, abal hu lo yitom kelum mehakkos, shehare kebar akal haapiqoman bebeto, vegam adayin lo gamar hahallel bebeto, veasur lishtot yayin qodem gemar hahallel. Veap al pi ken yakol hu lebarek lahem "bore peri haggapen" ap sheeno toem immahem kelum, lepi shebbirkat "bore peri haggapen" zo sheal kos shel qiddush enah kishar birkot hannehenin sheenan choba al haadam, velaken im hu eno neheneh kelum eno yakol lebarek kede lehotzi et mi sheeno yodea lebarek kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z, abal birkat "bore peri haggapen" zo hi choba kemo qiddush, velaken dinah kemo qiddush atzmo sheyyakol leqaddesh laacherim sheenan yodein leqaddesh ap shehu atzmo en tzarik leqiddush zeh, kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"g ayyen sham:

Veachar kak yaakilem yeraqot betibbul, vibarek lahem "bore peri haadama" im en bahem mi sheyyodea lebarek. Veap shehu lo yitom mehayraqot, shehare kebar akal haapiqoman — ap al pi ken yakol lebarek lahem, lepi sheggam birkat "bore peri haadama" zo enah kishar birkat hannehenin shehen reshut, ella hi kemo choba mechamat taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu leekol yaraq qodem hahaggada, vei epshar leoklo belo beraka, velaken dinah ke"bore peri haggapen" shel qiddush sheyyakol lebarek lahem ap sheeno toem kelum immahem:

Veachar kak omer lipnehem: "mah nishtanna" vekol hahaggada belashon shehem mebinim (o yeparesh lahem hainyan shetztzarik lomar meiqqar haddin, ayyen siman ta"g). Veachar kak hallel ad sop birkat "asher gealanu" ap im enan mebinim hallashon. Veachar kak yebarek lahem "bore peri haggapen", lepi minhag medinot ellu shennitbaer besiman ta"d, im en bahem mi sheyyodea lebarek, veyishtu kol echad koso. Veachar kak yoklu matztza umaror, vehu yebarek lahem "al akilat matztza" ve"al akilat maror", shekkol birkot hammitzvot ap mi sheyyatza kebar yede chobato — yakol lehotzi acherim sheenan yodein. Vegam "hammotzi" yakol lebarek lahem im en bahem mi sheyyodea lebarek ap shehu eno toem immahem, lepi shebbirkat "hammotzi" shel akilat matztza belel rishon hu choba kemo akilat matztza atzmah, vedinah ke"bore peri haggapen" shel qiddush kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z. Veachar kak yenichem leekol hakkerika vekol hasseuda ad leachar birkat hammazon, ubetok kak yelek hu lebayit acher veyaaseh kasseder hazzeh, veken lebayit shelishi urebii. Abal eno yakol lebarek lahem birkat hammazon, kevan shello akal immahem, vehattora omra: "veakalta vesabota uberakta", mi sheokel — hu yebarek, ayyen siman qp"v (ki sham nitbaer shemmiddibre soperim hu sheeno rashshay lebarek lahem birkat hammazon, umiqra zeh asmakta beolma hu), ayyen sham:

Veachar kak yelek lebeto ligmor hahallel vehahaggada libne beto, veachar kak yelek lebattehem ligmor lahem hahallel vehahaggada, vehem shotim kos rebii, vehu eno shoteh immahem, kevan shekkebar shata d' kosot. (Veim hu rotzeh — yakol lehaqdim ligmor hahallel vehaggada bebattehem, veyakol lishtot kos rebii bebayit echad mehem. Veim hem enan yodein lebarek birkat hammazon — yiqra hu immahem kol birkat hammazon milla bemilla, veeno kimbarek lebattala, kevan shehen onin acharayv kol milla umilla, vahare hu kemaqre et haqqatan umelammedo birkat hammazon achar akilato. Veachar kak yelek lebeto ligmor hahallel vehahaggada libne beto, vehem shotim kos harebii, vehu eno shoteh immahem im kebar shata beechad mehabbattim):

Veim hu rotzeh — yakol ligmor hahallel vehaggada mittechilla bebeto, veachar kak yelek lebattim acherim leqaddesh lahem velomar lahem hahaggada vehallel, velo yitom immahem ap min hakkos rebii im kebar shata kos harebii bebeto. Veim hu rotzeh lehaqdim laasot kol hasseder bebattim acherim velelek achar kak lebeto lehatchil hasseder miqqiddush vaelak — hareshut beyado. Veyizzaher shello litom kelum bebattehem, sheasur litom qodem qiddush, vehu eno yotze bemah shemmeqaddesh bebattehem, kevan sheeno soed sham bebattehem, veen qiddush ella bimqom seuda:

Abal eno yakol leqaddesh bitchilla bebeto velaasot kol hasseder ad leachar hakkerika velelek achar kak lebayit acher laasot ken, lepi sheasur leadam laaqor misseudato qodem birkat hammazon lelek lebayit acher ap sheddato lachazor limqomo leekol od ulebarek achar kak, ella im ken holek lidbar mitzva oberet kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"ch veqap"d, vekan en mitzva oberet, shehare yakol laasot hasseder bebattim acherim leachar sheyyigmor seudato vibarek birkat hammazon bebeto. Umikkol maqom, yakol laaqor misseudato qodem akilat haapiqoman veyelek lebayit acher veyaaseh lahem kol hasseder veyokal sham immahem haapiqoman vibarek sham immahem birkat hammazon, im hayeta dato lekak mittechilla keshebberak "hammotzi" sheyyigmor seudato bebayit acher vibarek sham, ayyen siman qa"ch veta"t:
